name: Mobile App Resilience Assessment
description: Evaluation of mobile application resilience controls against reverse engineering and tampering. Covers anti-tamper and integrity checks, code obfuscation, root/jailbreak and emulator detection, anti-debugging and anti-hooking, and device binding, assessed against OWASP MASVS-RESILIENCE and the corresponding MASTG tests. General Android and iOS security testing belongs to SWSEC-MOB-ANDROID and SWSEC-MOB-IOS.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to mobile resilience assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose and limits of mobile resilience controls
evidence: Can explain the MASVS-RESILIENCE control group and its role as defence-in-depth
Can describe common root/jailbreak detection, anti-debugging and obfuscation techniques
Understands why resilience controls delay rather than prevent a determined attacker

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Tests basic resilience controls under supervision
evidence: Bypassed standard root or jailbreak detection using Frida or Objection in a lab app
Identified the presence and type of obfuscation in a decompiled application
Repackaged an application to test signature and integrity verification

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses resilience controls against MASTG test cases
evidence: Independently assessed resilience of 5+ mobile applications against MASVS-RESILIENCE
Measures and reports the effort required to bypass each control rather than only pass/fail
Tests anti-debugging, anti-hooking and emulator detection on Android and iOS builds
Passed proficiency assessment on mobile resilience testing

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses commercial protection solutions and layered resilience schemes
evidence: Defeats commercial app shielding or RASP products including native-layer checks
Deobfuscates control-flow-flattened or string-encrypted code to locate protection logic
Advises clients on resilience control design relative to their threat model
Mentors junior testers on resilience assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on mobile resilience; defines evaluation methodology
evidence: Developed the lab's resilience evaluation methodology and effort-based rating scheme
Published research on bypassing or evaluating mobile protection mechanisms
Builds custom tooling for automated detection and bypass of protection schemes
Trains teams on advanced mobile anti-tamper analysis

assessment_methods.description: Assess a prepared mobile application with layered resilience controls, bypass each control and report effort and findings against MASVS-RESILIENCE
Review a submitted resilience assessment report for correct MASTG test coverage and justified effort ratings
